highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.150.8 update fixes region allocation and OpenGL texture sampling without changing managed APIs.

bullets.detail: Region construction budgets scanline storage for subdivided conics and rejects accumulation overflow, preventing an undersized buffer and out-of-bounds writes.

Disable GLES-invalid BGRA-as-RGBx upload capabilities and preserve nearest-filtered texture subset clamps when magnification or fractional mappings could sample neighboring texels. One-to-one integer-relative mappings retain their fast path.
